profile.ai-assistance-disclosure.en: ChatGPT only helps refine reports you request; StelyraAgent performs the calculations and provides the app’s fixed chart content. The name or nickname, relationship type when applicable, and calculated chart results are sent through StelyraAgent Relay. Your profile birth date, birth time and birthplace are not sent. You can use a nickname. After delivery is acknowledged, Relay deletes the report and no longer stores it. Turning this off stops future generation; saved reports remain readable.
profile.ai-assistance-disclosure.zh: ChatGPT 只辅助优化你主动请求的报告；星盘计算和 App 内固定内容由 StelyraAgent 提供。名字或昵称、适用时的关系类型及已计算星盘结果会经 StelyraAgent Relay 发送，不会发送 Profile 中的出生日期、出生时间和出生地点；如担心姓名泄露，可以使用昵称。确认交付后 Relay 会删除报告且不再保存。关闭后只阻止未来生成，已保存报告仍可阅读。
profile.ai-assistance-disclosure.es: ChatGPT solo ayuda a perfeccionar los informes que solicitas; StelyraAgent realiza los cálculos y proporciona el contenido fijo de la app. Se envían mediante StelyraAgent Relay el nombre o apodo, el tipo de relación cuando corresponda y los resultados calculados. No se envían la fecha, hora ni lugar de nacimiento del perfil. Puedes usar un apodo. Tras confirmar la entrega, Relay elimina el informe y deja de conservarlo. Desactivarlo detiene futuras generaciones; los informes guardados siguen siendo legibles.
profile.ai-assistance-disclosure.fr: ChatGPT aide uniquement à améliorer les rapports que vous demandez ; StelyraAgent effectue les calculs et fournit le contenu fixe de l’app. Le nom ou surnom, le type de relation le cas échéant et les résultats calculés sont envoyés via StelyraAgent Relay. La date, l’heure et le lieu de naissance du profil ne sont pas envoyés. Vous pouvez utiliser un surnom. Après confirmation de la livraison, Relay supprime le rapport et ne le conserve plus. La désactivation empêche les futures générations ; les rapports enregistrés restent lisibles.
profile.ai-assistance-disclosure.tr: ChatGPT yalnızca istediğiniz raporları geliştirmeye yardımcı olur; hesaplamaları StelyraAgent yapar ve uygulamanın sabit harita içeriğini sağlar. Ad veya takma ad, uygulanabildiğinde ilişki türü ve hesaplanan harita sonuçları StelyraAgent Relay üzerinden gönderilir. Profilinizin doğum tarihi, doğum saati ve doğum yeri gönderilmez. Takma ad kullanabilirsiniz. Teslimat onaylandıktan sonra Relay raporu siler ve artık saklamaz. Bunu kapatmak gelecekteki oluşturmayı durdurur; kayıtlı raporlar okunmaya devam eder.
profile.ai-assistance-disclosure.de: ChatGPT hilft nur dabei, von dir angeforderte Berichte zu verfeinern; StelyraAgent führt die Berechnungen durch und stellt die festen Horoskopinhalte der App bereit. Name oder Spitzname, gegebenenfalls die Art der Beziehung sowie die berechneten Horoskopergebnisse werden über StelyraAgent Relay gesendet. Geburtsdatum, Geburtszeit und Geburtsort deines Profils werden nicht gesendet. Du kannst einen Spitznamen verwenden. Nach bestätigter Zustellung löscht Relay den Bericht und speichert ihn nicht weiter. Wenn du dies deaktivierst, werden künftig keine neuen Berichte erzeugt; gespeicherte Berichte bleiben lesbar.
profile.ai-assistance-disclosure.it: ChatGPT aiuta solo a perfezionare i report che richiedi; StelyraAgent esegue i calcoli e fornisce i contenuti fissi delle carte dell’app. Il nome o soprannome, il tipo di relazione quando applicabile e i risultati calcolati del tema vengono inviati tramite StelyraAgent Relay. La data, l’ora e il luogo di nascita del profilo non vengono inviati. Puoi usare un soprannome. Dopo la conferma della consegna, Relay elimina il report e non lo conserva più. Disattivando questa opzione si interrompe la generazione futura; i report salvati restano leggibili.
profile.ai-assistance-disclosure.ko: ChatGPT는 사용자가 요청한 보고서를 다듬는 데만 도움을 줍니다. 계산과 앱의 고정 차트 콘텐츠 제공은 StelyraAgent가 수행합니다. 이름 또는 닉네임, 해당되는 경우 관계 유형, 계산된 차트 결과가 StelyraAgent Relay를 통해 전송됩니다. 프로필의 출생일, 출생 시간, 출생지는 전송되지 않습니다. 닉네임을 사용할 수 있습니다. 전달이 확인되면 Relay는 보고서를 삭제하고 더 이상 보관하지 않습니다. 이 옵션을 끄면 이후 새 보고서 생성이 중단되지만 저장된 보고서는 계속 읽을 수 있습니다.
profile.ai-assistance-disclosure.pt-BR: ChatGPT only helps refine reports you request; StelyraAgent performs the calculations and provides the app’s fixed chart content. The name or nickname, relationship type when applicable, and calculated chart results are sent through StelyraAgent Relay. Your profile birth date, birth time and birthplace are not sent. You can use a nickname. After delivery is acknowledged, Relay deletes the report and no longer stores it. Turning this off stops future generation; saved reports remain readable.
